description: This file implements the DeviceInfo plugin for WPEFramework, providing device-related information retrieval, initialization, deinitialization, and connection management.

classes.name: DeviceInfo
classes.description: A class implementing the device information plugin, managing device info, capabilities, and connection lifecycle.

methods.name: DeviceInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing member variables and logging startup.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service, sets up device info and capabilities, and registers plugin interfaces.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters interfaces, releases references, and terminates connections.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns a string describing the plugin's purpose.
